visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A very muscular, grey-haired man without a shirt climbs a vertical concrete pillar under an overpass. He wears black shorts and flip-flops. (2) A younger man in a white T-shirt with a black shoulder bag approaches, pointing at the muscular man who is now using a step-machine exerciser. (3) The two men stand together in a park-like setting with palm trees; the muscular man flexes his biceps while the younger man talks excitedly. (4) Close-ups show the muscular man performing high jumps and more climbing. (5) The younger man presents a large green box of Cadina brand pea chips. (6) Close-up shots display the triangular green chips in a white bowl, followed by the packaging showing nutritional information and text. (7) The muscular man sits outdoors eating the chips with a look of extreme satisfaction. (8) The younger man is in a large warehouse-style supermarket, piling boxes of the chips into a shopping cart.

[Subtitle]: 非油炸, 無防腐劑, 無麩質. (14) [Subtitle]: 一包還有15.2g的蛋白質, 非常適合你吃. (15) [Variety]: (試吃中..). [Subtitle]: 美味. 真的很好吃誒. (16) [Subtitle]: 吃了之後身體都不會有負擔, 而且很適合全家吃, 你也吃一點. (17) [Variety]: 很滿意. (18) [Slogan]: 即日起至8/17. 卡迪那 豌豆脆片. 折價60元. 現在特價一箱只要239啊.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: One muscular elderly man, one younger interviewer, and two female shoppers in the background of the supermarket scene.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: One muscular middle-aged man with grey hair, no shirt, and black athletic shorts. One younger male host wearing a white T-shirt and a black shoulder strap bag.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions from an outdoor public park with exercise equipment, tropical trees, and concrete infrastructure to the interior of a large warehouse supermarket with industrial shelving and bulk products.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a fast-paced electronic BGM with a bright synth lead and a strong 4/4 beat. A young male voice speaks in a high-arousal, excited tone. (2) A sharp 'Whoosh' transition SFX triggers a shift to an interaction phase. A second, deeper male voice responds with a friendly, booming tone. The BGM remains constant at roughly 124 BPM. (3) A 'Ding' bell SFX occurs as product details are highlighted. Dialogue becomes rapid, alternating between the two speakers. (4) Distinct, percussive 'Crunch' SFX are introduced during the tasting segment, synchronized with eating movements. (5) The young male speaker adopts a broadcast-style delivery to announce sale prices, with audible supermarket reverb and a slight increase in BGM volume for the finale.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Interaction -> Problem -> Solution -> Promotion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a comedic encounter with a 'superhuman' fit senior in a park to hook the audience, then pivots into a health-focused product endorsement for Cadina Green Pea Chips, emphasizing their protein content and current discount at a warehouse store.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The host directly presents the product, lists its nutritional benefits, and explicitly provides pricing and store availability information.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A typical social-media style short-form advertisement that uses influencer-style comedy tropes to lead into a direct retail sales pitch.
